objective: Build ABG Pulse into a dependable, comprehensive and auditable ABG intelligence platform that lets a senior user understand in under 60 seconds what materially changed across the Aditya Birla Group ecosystem, why it matters, what may become important next and whether to act, watch or ignore—with every factual claim traceable to evidence and every coverage gap visible.

measurement.verifiedFormula: Verified completion = sum(milestone weight × verified completion) / 100.
measurement.implementationFormula: Built completion = sum(milestone weight × implementation completion) / 100.
rules: Verified progress moves only when the acceptance evidence exists.
Built progress may include coded and tested work that is not yet live or independently proven.
The gap between built and verified is shown explicitly; it is never counted as delivered.
Blocked work remains visible and keeps its remaining weight.
The 30-day dependability milestone requires 30 actual operating days.
